scope: Close the remaining source-level classification of mutating Realtime voice tools: direct durable memory mutation, research-request submission, confirmed task delegation into Claude Code, and the difference between repository-declared hooks and proved host/runtime EffectGate reachability. No donor execution was performed.

atoms.what_it_does: frank_erinnerung_schreiben validates only non-empty subject/value and directly dispatches stern gespraech-erinnerung-schreiben with quelle=realtime-tool; it does not use the two-step voice task confirmation gate.
atoms.why_it_exists: Low-latency durable conversation memory from the live voice session.
atoms.failure_mode: Model-selected wording may become durable memory without an explicit typed distinction among quote, summary, inference, instruction and verified fact.
atoms.concurrency_implication: No immutable Realtime call_id/request_digest is visibly carried into the memory-admission wrapper.
atoms.privacy_implication: Spoken content can be persisted; retention and sensitivity policy are not enforced in this wrapper.
known_counterevidence: The downstream writer is narrow and may intentionally represent remembered conversation rather than canonical world fact; end-to-end read semantics still need proof.
open_questions: Define MemoryCandidate/MemoryAdmission and bind provenance plus causal/admission identity before durable promotion or factual use.

atoms.what_it_does: frank_forschung with aktion=neu_anstossen accepts one Realtime model function call, validates only a non-empty question, then starts a background bridge whose worker calls stern chatgpt-senden. The two-step frank_auftrag_stellen confirmation mechanism is not applied to this submission path.
atoms.why_it_exists: Allow explicit spoken requests to launch asynchronous research without blocking the live conversation.
outputs: background research request id and later result
atoms.failure_mode: The schema/persona says the tool is only for explicit user requests, but the local dispatcher does not independently prove or bind that human intent before submission.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Each request receives a background bridge id, but that id is not shown as a canonical EffectDecision or request-digest capability.
atoms.privacy_implication: The spoken research question is forwarded to the research bridge/provider surface.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Asynchronous; exact provider/economic route is outside this span and must remain independently governed.
known_counterevidence: The persona/tool description explicitly instructs use only after an explicit user research request; that is behavioral guidance, not a deterministic local intent gate.
open_questions: Classify research submission as a typed capability/effect class and bind explicit HumanIntentDecision plus economic/provider admission where network execution is possible.

atoms.subsystem: realtime voice / delegated Claude Code executor
atoms.what_it_does: After the separate voice task-confirmation gate dispatches work, claude_frage launches claude -p with --permission-mode set from berechtigung and unconditionally --disallowedTools Bash. Bash is therefore source-level blocked for this voice-delegated worker even if permissions.allow is broad. The source explicitly states Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob remain available.
atoms.why_it_exists: Prevent speech-triggered destructive shell execution while retaining file-oriented Claude Code work.
writes: possible downstream file edits through allowed non-Bash tools
atoms.failure_mode: Blocking Bash narrows blast radius but does not make task confirmation equivalent to executor-consumed authorization for every allowed Write/Edit or other state-changing tool call.
atoms.concurrency_implication: A resumed Claude session may produce multiple state-changing tool calls from one admitted voice task; no immutable voice call_id/request_digest is visibly consumed per downstream effect at this function boundary.
atoms.privacy_implication: Confirmed task text enters the Claude Code process and may be exposed to its configured tools/context.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Headless subprocess with up to configured timeout; cost_usd is returned by the CLI result but does not itself establish authorization/economic admission.
tests_or_receipts: Source comments record historical local tests of --disallowedTools precedence; this Triggerword-5 run did not re-execute them.
known_counterevidence: A separately installed PreToolUse hook may add stronger enforcement downstream; its actual registration and invocation for this headless process is not established by claude_frage source alone.
open_questions: Require every downstream mutation to consume one-shot EffectDecision bound to invocation/tool_use id, request digest, generation, capability/resource and policy version.

atoms.what_it_does: The donor hook manifest declares PreToolUse and PostToolUse matchers '*' that invoke scripts/stern.py hook, alongside session/prompt/stop hooks.
atoms.why_it_exists: Route Claude Code lifecycle events through the consolidated stern dispatcher.
outputs: stern.py hook invocation when this manifest is actually installed and active
atoms.failure_mode: FILE_EXISTS != LIVE_RUNTIME: repository presence of hooks.json cannot prove that the current host, plugin version, headless claude -p process and exact delegated call actually load/fire it or that its decision is executor-consumed.
atoms.concurrency_implication: Matcher '*' is broad by declaration; exact invocation correlation still requires immutable per-call identity and runtime receipt.
atoms.latency_or_cost_implication: Declared 2s PreToolUse and 3s PostToolUse hook timeouts.
runtime_entrypoints: Claude Code lifecycle if plugin manifest is registered
known_counterevidence: Other project evidence may show live hook firing on specific hosts, but that evidence must be exact-version/source-bound and cannot be inferred from this file.
open_questions: Recover exact current host/plugin registration plus a source-bound headless voice-delegation receipt proving PreToolUse -> decision -> allowed/denied executor behavior.

hypotheses: Frankenstein-2.0 should classify Realtime outputs into read-only observation, MemoryCandidate, TaskCandidate, ResearchRequestCandidate and SessionControl before any mutating path is admitted.
Human task confirmation and Bash denial are useful orthogonal controls but neither is a substitute for one-shot executor-consumed EffectDecision per real mutation.
counterhypotheses: The installed Claude plugin may already fire stern PreToolUse for every allowed Write/Edit and may already deny unauthorized mutations; exact host/runtime evidence could reduce the implementation delta, but source/config files alone cannot establish that.

Research submission might be intentionally classified as non-world-effect coordination; even then it can consume provider/browser resources and transmit user text, so its capability/economic/privacy admission still needs an explicit class rather than silent equivalence to a read.
contradictions: TW5-CONTRADICTION-REALTIME-RESEARCH-INTENT-011 OPEN: frank_forschung neu_anstossen relies on model/tool-description compliance for explicit-user-request intent and has no local two-step confirmation equivalent to frank_auftrag_stellen.

TW5-CONTRADICTION-DELEGATED-EFFECT-COVERAGE-012 OPEN: claude_frage hard-blocks Bash but leaves state-changing file tools available; source does not bind voice intent/call identity to an executor-consumed EffectDecision per downstream mutation.
TW5-CONTRADICTION-HOOK-REACHABILITY-013 OPEN: hooks.json declares PreToolUse '*' but current exact host/headless-process registration and firing are not proved by repository source.
critical_unknowns: Exact installed hook/plugin version and PreToolUse firing for the current headless claude -p process spawned from voice.
Exact downstream stern PreToolUse decision semantics for allowed non-Bash mutation tools at the current donor/version.
Exact provider/economic/privacy admission path for stern.chatgpt_senden when frank_forschung starts new work.

recommended_next_spans.reason: Bind PreToolUse zulassen/decision state and PostToolUse journal semantics to the current hook manifest, especially non-Bash Write/Edit coverage.
Trace chatgpt_senden route and economic/privacy guard semantics for frank_forschung neu_anstossen.
Prove hooks.json is actually loaded for the headless voice-delegated claude -p path; do not infer runtime coverage from repository presence.
